description: Rothco’s Thin Blue Line Flag Reusable Face Mask is designed with a soft and stretchy 3-layer polyester construction that comfortably conforms to the shape of your face. This washable and reusable mask is perfect for everyday use, offering both practicality and a meaningful statement. It features an adjustable nose bridge and secure ear loops on each end to hold the mask in place. The face covering panel measures 7 inches wide x 5 inches high (3 ¼ inches at the sides), providing ample coverage. Available in two sizes, SM/MD with a span of 11 inches (extended but not stretched) and LG/XL with a span of 14 inches (extended but not stretched), these masks are a must-have addition to your daily essentials. Please note, these masks are not medical-grade surgical masks or N95 respirator masks, and Rothco makes no warranties regarding the prevention of infection or transmission of viruses or diseases. Proceeds from this purchase benefit families of fallen first responders.
